name: github
description: GitHub: search repos/code/issues, read repos/issues/PRs/files, notifications, and create issues — authenticated via a personal access token or OAuth device flow.

token.title: Personal access token
token.description: A GitHub PAT. The simplest way to authenticate. Leave blank to use OAuth device flow instead (requires a client ID below).

clientId.title: OAuth client ID
clientId.description: Client ID of a GitHub OAuth App with device flow enabled. Only needed for browser login when no token is provided.

readOnly.title: Read-only
readOnly.description: Disable write tools such as creating issues (search/read only).
